title: Pure P.U.N.K.
summary: P.U.N.K. cards only, with generic staples. The Level 3 Psychic Tuners pay 600 LP each for a search or a Fusion Summon, so the deck lives off its Life Points. Ze Amin searches a P.U.N.K. monster, Wa Gon a Spell, and Madame Spider a Trap, while Ukiyoe-P.U.N.K. Sharakusai Fusion Summons on your turn and Synchro Summons on theirs. The 2025 pair leads. Noh-P.U.N.K. Rising Scale banishes a P.U.N.K. card to summon itself, then adds or summons another P.U.N.K. from the Deck or GY and flips a big opposing monster face-down when it activates. P.U.N.K. JAM FEVER! is a Rank 8 stacked on a P.U.N.K. Fusion or Synchro that draws and negates. P.U.N.K. JAM Extreme Session draws each time a Psychic pays LP.
